summary: IPV Fase 4 (unidades + fracción) frontend+integration smoke on preview. Admin: created fraction product (unit=libra, stock 10.5), stock cell = '10.5 lb', min/target inputs step=0.001. Entrada 2.25 lb -> stock 12.75 lb (no float drift). Count 12.5 -> badge 'FALTANTE -0.25'. Unit product rejects qty 2.5 with 400 and 'por unidad' toast; qty 3 accepted. Reorder panel loads with fmtQty-formatted rows (test fraction product correctly not listed because stock 11.25 > min 4). Client (VIP): marketplace shows price '5 USDT/lb' and stock '12.75 lb'; redeem dialog qty step=0.001; redeeming 1.5 lb with store pickup succeeded, history row shows '1.5 lb', stock decremented to '11.25 lb'. No raw i18n keys ('units.*') leaked in admin or client. All 10 test items from the request verified green.

issues: Several Radix DialogContent components missing aria-describedby/Description (a11y warnings in console on add-product, add-movement, redeem dialogs).

action_items: (Optional, a11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to add-product, add-movement, and redeem DialogContent to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: fmtQty + unitAbbr correctly applied across InventoryControlTab (stock cell), InventoryMovementsTab (qty cell), and MarketplaceView (price suffix, stock, history). No fallback 'units.xxx' leaks observed.
qtyStep(unit) wired to all decimal-aware number inputs (inv-product-stock, inventory-min/target-input-*, movement-qty, restock-qty, redeem-qty) — step=0.001 for libra/kg confirmed in DOM.

Reorder panel filter is 'stock <= min_stock' (strict) — the request wording 'stock below target' is actually only enforced via target in the suggested-qty calc, which is correct and matches existing Fase 3 behavior.
Floating-point idempotency verified end-to-end: 10.5 + 2.25 -> exactly 12.75 displayed; after redeem of 1.5 -> exactly 11.25 (no 12.749999... drift).

success_rate.backend: 100% (curl-smoke pre-verified + fraction/unit paths exercised via UI)
